name: tram-mcp
description: Connect Claude to your TestRail instance. Browse the API, search test cases, and manage runs and results — all through natural language. Self-contained Node bundle; no toolchain required.

testrail_api_key.title: TestRail API key (or password)
testrail_api_key.description: Generate under My Settings > API Keys in TestRail. Your account password also works.

tools.name: check_testrail_auth
tools.description: Verify TestRail credentials with a structured diagnosis

tools.name: browse_testrail_api
tools.description: List all TestRail API categories and methods

tools.name: describe_testrail_method
tools.description: Parameter/endpoint details for one API method

tools.name: search_test_cases
tools.description: Search test cases by title within a project

tools.name: get_run_summary
tools.description: Run status counts, pass rate, and failed-test list

tools.name: create_test_run
tools.description: Start a run for all or selected cases
